scope: Portable routing manifest for agent access to Mem.ai; does not grant permissions or install an agent.

mem_ai.auth: OAuth through each MCP client; server-side REST secret reference only

glaciereq_gateway.auth: gateway credential from authorized runtime secret store only

claude_code.install: claude mcp add --transport http mem https://mcp.mem.ai/mcp

gemini_cli.install: gemini mcp add -s user -t http mem https://mcp.mem.ai/mcp

claude_web.install: Customize > Connectors > Mem OR custom connector https://mcp.mem.ai/mcp

chatgpt.install: Mem app in ChatGPT plugin directory

omp_glacier.install: Use existing OMP native .omp MCP profile; resolve exact supported transport and syntax in running build
omp_glacier.auth: per-runtime authorized OAuth/secret integration; do not inherit ChatGPT auth

boot_sequence: Resolve current Operator intent to the correct work-unit and permission scope
Authenticate Mem from THIS host through supported MCP or API and inspect enabled capabilities
Initialize MCP and enumerate available provider tools
Exact-ID read living_handoff and compare current version/supersession
For systems work exact-ID read systems_auto_boot, federation_charter and memory_mesh_map; otherwise resolve and read the task-specific owner note
Recover authoritative source objects from their source providers, not inferred from Mem
Execute within authorized boundaries then independently verify material provider-side effects
Version-checked Mem continuation update to existing owner note when supported, followed by exact-ID readback

requirements.write_semantics: Mem update replaces complete Markdown note; require exact latest version and independent readback
